name: @ship/sui-mermaid
description: SUI mermaid pack — <sui-mermaid>, renders mermaid source text to a themed SVG with an error tile. Mermaid is heavy, so this pack is its own deck bundle, framework-external, lazy-loaded.

scripts.prepublishOnly: test -f dist/custom-elements.json || (cd ../../../.. && cargo run -p deck-cli -- build-assets)
